site.name: Leafnote
site.author: The Leafnote team
site.home_lede: Leafnote is a watering reminder app for houseplants. This is a fictional demo project for ProofPress.
site.footer_text: Leafnote is a fictional app used to demo ProofPress.

cta.heading: Get watering reminders with Leafnote
cta.text: Set a schedule per plant and get a reminder on the day it's due.

product.name: Leafnote
product.one_liner: A watering reminder app for houseplants
product.audience: People with 5 to 50 houseplants who keep forgetting which plant needs water
product.pricing: Free to download, with an optional Plus subscription. Never state a price.

features.name: Per-plant watering schedules
features.detail: Each plant gets its own interval in days; the app reminds you on the day it's due.

features.name: Snooze and skip
features.detail: Push a reminder by one to three days, or skip it if the soil is still wet.

features.name: Watering log
features.detail: Every watering is logged with the date, so you can see the real interval over time.

features.name: Seasonal adjustment
features.detail: Lengthen all intervals by a percentage for winter with one setting.

features.name: CSV export
features.detail: Export the watering log as a CSV file.

not_exist: No sharing with other household members
product.positioning: Leafnote fits someone with enough plants that a calendar gets messy. Someone with three plants is fine with a phone calendar; someone who wants plant ID or diagnosis needs a different app.
phrasing_rules: Don't promise plants will survive or thrive
No timing claims like 'set up in 30 seconds'

voice.audience: Houseplant owners reading on a phone, mostly beginners to intermediate
voice.tone: A friend who keeps a lot of plants: practical, calm, a little dry
do: Use worked examples with obviously illustrative numbers
Say when the answer is 'it depends' and on what
dont: No fake personal stories or testimonials

factcheck.topics: Toxicity of plants to pets or children; any claim about plant species' needs that goes beyond common care-guide consensus.

sources.name: ASPCA toxic and non-toxic plants list

factcheck.rules: Name the specific plant when giving watering advice; never give one interval for 'all plants'.
